explanation: Swedish programmer Markus Persson swapped the height and length values, making a tall, thin pig. He turned it green and made it creep up on players and explode.

claims.text: The Creeper in Minecraft came from a mistake Markus Persson made while modelling a pig.
The Enderman, the Ghast and the Zombie did not come from the pig modelling mistake.
Persson accidentally swapped the height and length of the pig model, producing a tall, thin creature.
Markus Persson, who created Minecraft, is Swedish.
